message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a caricature of a man in a black suit standing in profile, facing a large, rectangular wooden mirror. He has a receding hairline and a slight smile. He is reaching forward, placing both hands on the shoulders of another figure visible inside the mirror. The figure in the mirror is a caricature with similar facial features but is wearing a white military-style uniform with gold buttons and a peaked cap adorned with a circular emblem. The man in the mirror has his eyes closed and a subtle smile.

The background is a dark, gradient teal. Large white block letters at the top read "TEMPO". Smaller text at the top left says "Sampah Plastik Kita Sampai ke Laut Afrika H.92" and at the top right, "Cari Muka Makan Siang Gratis H.80". In the lower left, white text reads "DINASTI TIADA HENTI" followed by a paragraph of Indonesian text. The bottom right displays the date "13-19 MEI 2024", price "RP 50.000", website "MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO", and a barcode. The overall style uses smooth digital painting with dramatic lighting.
